plugins.description: Embed rust-curl-impersonate's C ABI (17 functions, ABI v2) from Python, Java/Kotlin, Go, Node, PHP, C#, Swift, C/C++ or Android. Ships the downloader, the ABI verifier, a declaration generator, and ready-made ctypes and JNA bindings.
